items.statement: The investigation uses the explicitly defined G2plus/three-beta-CD system as an isolated +2 singlet complex and verifies retrieved molecular identity.
items.expected: Identity, 1:3 stoichiometry, +2 charge and singlet multiplicity are documented.

items.statement: The final structure and electronic analysis are validated rather than asserted.
items.expected: The report gives optimization/convergence evidence, connectivity and geometry checks, and reproducible orbital evidence.

items.statement: The frontier-orbital fragment assignments identify host/guest donor–acceptor character.
items.expected: HOMO is primarily host-localized and LUMO primarily guest-localized for the validated complex.

items.statement: The closest specified hydroxyl-O···pyridinium-N contact is measured from final coordinates.
items.expected: A named atom pair and value near 3.058 Å are reported using the defined exhaustive atom-class search.
